baseline.name: ALWAYS_NO_FINDING
baseline.purpose: Non-learned prevalence control on exactly the same labels; not a prior production model.

evaluated_condition: Review-worthy follow-up under the pre-authored supplied context, never real fraud, entitlement or confirmed error.

label_access: The authoring agent has seen all labels. Evaluation here means an authored split, not an unseen holdout.
limitations: Small synthetic developer/agent-authored convenience sample, not independent, representative or bank-validated data; no confidence or real-world fraud claims.
Supplied explanatory context is available to labels but production checkup accepts classified rows only. Context-aware false positives are intentional task gaps.
Bank-style strings are artificial examples, not evidence of real institution format coverage. Account aliases do not establish ownership.
Family disjointness is enforced by declared base_family_id and exact source hash; semantic independence of different families requires human review.
Presence metrics can hide incorrect localisation or several alerts in a kind; inspect exact evidence coverage and all raw findings.
No production parameter was changed. Do not tune on this report and then describe this same split as held out.

For a future blind test, a teammate must review labels and create new unseen base families, freeze hashes, seal labels from implementers, run once, and record label access before interpreting results.

manifest.label_origin: Pre-authored by a development agent from fictional scenario context, before running this evaluator. Not derived at runtime from production predictions.
manifest.review_status: UNREVIEWED_AGENT_AUTHORED; no teammate review, bank review, independent validation or blind validation completed

split_protocol.assignment: Conservative scenario-lineage grouping, never random rows. All structurally related amount/narration/account-alias transformations stay together, including basic and bank-style examples. Entire repeated-entry and recorded-fee lineages are tuning; remaining lineages are evaluation. Some evaluation finding kinds therefore have zero positives.
split_protocol.blind_status: NOT_BLIND: same authoring agent wrote and has seen all labels. No parameter tuning is permitted after evaluation exposure.
split_protocol.future_holdout: A teammate must review or replace labels, author unseen base families, freeze source/label hashes, seal labels from implementers and record one first run. This authored split cannot be rebranded as independent validation.
split_protocol.split_revision: Lineage grouping hardened after the first authored run exposed results. Labels and all overall counts unchanged. This split is already observed and cannot support a blind claim. Frozen case ID prefixes are historical identifiers, not split membership.

target_definitions.FEES: Recorded fees whose purpose or authorisation still needs review; already explained fees do not.
target_definitions.RECURRING_INCREASE: An unexplained increase in the same regular obligation needs follow-up, including known changed bank narration.
target_definitions.REFUND_AMBIGUITY: Several purchase allocations remain possible and require confirmation.
target_definitions.REFUND_LINK_WITHHELD: A refund cannot be reconciled from supplied records and its relationship remains unresolved.
target_definitions.REFUND_PARTIAL_TRAIL: An expected purchase return remains only partly reconciled and needs confirmation; this does not establish money owed.
target_definitions.REPEATED_ENTRY: An unexplained matching or plausibly duplicated entry needs follow-up; confirmed separate purchases do not.
target_definitions.UNCLEAR_CREDIT: A credit source is unresolved; supplied evidence of borrowing, refund, transfer or salary resolves this target.
target_definitions.UNUSUAL_AMOUNT: An unexplained exceptional expense with sufficient relevant history needs follow-up; a supplied planned purchase does not.

unit: One binary case × finding-kind presence decision; 8 explicit kinds per case. Multiple same-kind findings count once. Exact evidence coverage is reported separately.
